gaps: No supported private character-data API is claimed.
Browser/session-backed discovery, dice forwarding, and OCR are out of scope.
patterns: Use a user-authorized local snapshot or official exported PDF rather than account automation.

novel_features.name: Local character snapshot and PDF inspection
novel_features.description: Normalize a user-supplied D&D Beyond or Beyond20 character snapshot or exported PDF.
novel_features.rationale: Bounded local sharing covers the requested character-sheet use without a private API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can read an authorized character artifact without account access or mutations.
